properties.description: Seven tests: nothing_to_close is not told it never closed; a typed pass reads never_closed and is said in next; never_closed does not affect clean; an agreeing recorded run stamps the check and leaves status alone; an unrecorded run stamps nothing; a failure fed back then fixed still reads a_failure_came_back; a check typed failing is not a failure that came back.
properties.findings: 7/7 pass. Mutation-checked: removing the stamp call in reconcile_verification fails exactly the two tests that depend on it (agreeing-run trace; failure-then-fixed).
properties.name: A result that came back is visible, and one that never did is said
